description: A button with after and 3d-button styling.
howItWorks: Move your mouse over it and it reacts; move away and it returns to its resting state.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Nervous Chipmunk 95</title>
<style>
/* From Uiverse.io by fcb4355 - https://uiverse.io/fcb4355/nervous-chipmunk-95 */
/* From Uiverse.io by fcb4355 - Tags: button, after, 3d button */
.button {
  position: relative;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  border: none;
  color: #007ffe;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: .3s;
  transition-delay: .3s;
  z-index: 0;
}

.button::after {
  position: absolute;
  content: '';
  width: 17px;
  height: 17px;
  background-color: #007ffe;
  right: -20px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  transition: .3s;
  opacity: 0;
}

.button::before {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 0;
  content: '';
  width: 17px;
  height: 17px;
  background-color: #007ffe;
  left: -20px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  transition: .3s;
  opacity: 0;
}

button:hover::after {
  z-index: -1;
  right: 0;
  width: 50%;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 0;
  opacity: 1;
}

button:hover::before {
  z-index: -1;
  left: 0;
  width: 50%;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 0;
  opacity: 1;
}

button:hover {
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 10px 50px 50px rgba(52, 152, 219,.2);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  Button
</button>
</body>
</html>
